title: A PR that changes the mutation harness runs a CI-sized mutate-guard run before it joins a batch
why: Coordinator mistake, 06:18 CST Nov 9 (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard): #1597 was pulled into batch 68 to raise the mutate-guard cap, but it also changed the mutation harness (a clean-layout control), which timed out on every target in CI: 670 of 694 unknown, run 42620238014. No check runs a PR that changes hooks/mutate_*.py through a CI-sized checks-mutate-guard before it joins a batch. FIRST COST SAMPLE 12:14 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 12:13, from the #3413 lane's message and PR body; the coordinator did not run it; triage read none): #3413 (draft; replaces #2733, whose pushed commit had no Red-run trailer, so the lint's remedy was a replacement PR) is titled "lane lint runs the mutation test when a ... changes". On the lane's own machine, not CI: lane lint 2706.2 s with the mutation run (shards 1209 + 563 + 565 s) against 352.6 s for plain lint, one run each (n=1). The extra cost is 2353.6 s by subtraction. Triage matched #3413 to this step and to mutate-harness-change-timed-run by title only; which step the lane builds is unread.
note: Fix: when a PR touches hooks/mutate_*.py, the merge tool's lane lint (or the PR's own dispatch run) runs checks-mutate-guard on the PR head and reports its time and unknown count. Red case first. Filed 07:23 CST Nov 9. Related: steps lane-lint-checks-from-batch and lane-lint-cheap-checks-first. Page item 463 (mutate-harness-lane-run, 09:03 CST Nov 9): may a lane that touches hooks/mutate_*.py run the mutation job's command, against ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job? #2443 held until it is answered. Owner pick on the waiting page (13:09 CST Nov 9): item 463 a. Ruling lanes-run-no-full-ci-job gains one named exception: for a lane that changes the mutation harness, its own suite is the mutation job, run before the batch. #2443 is released with its decision edit. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-mutate-harness-change-timed-run]). Lane code-workflows started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
